Class MoleculeRenderer

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.client.MoleculeRenderer
public final class MoleculeRenderer extends Object
Handles the rendering, tessellation, geometric transformation, and animation calculations for chemical molecules, atoms, and bonds in 3D space.

    • renderInViewport

      public static void renderInViewport(MoleculeStructure molecule, int left, int top, int width, int height, int imageSize, float yaw, float pitch, float panX, float panY, float zoom, int clipLeft, int clipTop, int clipRight, int clipBottom)
      Keeps the viewport's framing and zoom center while allowing the model to move across a larger card. The clip rectangle is still intersected with the caller's scissor, so neighboring HEI cards remain protected.
      Parameters:
      molecule - authored structure
      left - initial viewport left
      top - initial viewport top
      width - initial viewport width
      height - initial viewport height
      imageSize - fitted image size
      yaw - camera yaw in degrees
      pitch - camera pitch in degrees
      panX - horizontal pan in GUI pixels
      panY - vertical pan in GUI pixels
      zoom - positive camera zoom
      clipLeft - outer card left
      clipTop - outer card top
      clipRight - outer card right
      clipBottom - outer card bottom
